brief.zh: 这台双目相机的焦距 × 基线 f·b = 3。把视差图换成距离图：z = f·b / d（米）。
brief.en: This stereo camera's focal length × baseline is f·b = 3. Turn the disparity map into a distance map: z = f·b / d (metres).

hint.zh: 一个常数除以一整张图，常数用在每一格上。
hint.en: A constant divided by a whole picture applies to every cell.

after.zh: 距离和视差成反比：视差差一格，近处只差几厘米，远处可能差好几米，深度误差约是 z²/(f·b)。要让远处测得准，就要加宽基线或换长焦，可近处的视差又会大得超出搜索范围。
after.en: Distance is inversely proportional to disparity: a one-pixel slip in disparity is a few centimetres up close but can be metres far away, with a depth error of about z²/(f·b). To measure far things precisely you widen the baseline or use a longer lens, but then the disparity of near things grows past the search range.

t.zh: 知道了视差，还要换成米。距离、视差、镜头焦距 f、两台相机的间距 b（叫基线）之间有一个固定的关系，它和小孔成像是同一个道理。
t.en: Once you know the disparity, you still need to turn it into metres. Distance, disparity, the lens focal length f and the spacing b between the two cameras (called the baseline) are tied by a fixed relationship, and it follows from the same idea as the pinhole camera.

t.zh: 机器人靠双目相机躲障碍。视差只能按像素算，差一个像素，报出的距离就差一截；视差太大，又会超出相机能搜索的范围，那就配不上了。
t.en: A robot uses stereo cameras to avoid obstacles. Disparity can only be measured in whole pixels, so being off by one pixel puts the reported distance off by a fair amount; and if the disparity is too large, it falls outside the range the camera can search, so no match is found.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：把视差图换成距离图，公式在说明里。
t.en: Your task in this level: turn the disparity map into a distance map; the formula is in the brief.
